caption: The drawing depicts a garment resembling a cape or shawl displayed on a simple, collar-only mannequin form. The main garment is the central focus, occupying the middle portion of the image, and is shown with a patterned fabric, featuring small repetitive floral or star-shaped motifs in shades of brown and off-white. The edges of the cape are outlined with a solid, darker brown border. The cape is open at the front, creating a symmetrical, mirrored appearance. In the upper right corner of the page, there is a secondary, simplified line sketch of the same garment, showing its overall shape without detailing the pattern or colors. The background is plain and beige, and the illustration in the foreground is rendered with ink and watercolor, clearly distinguishing the patterned section from the solid border, with the collar left white.
title: Cape
